result.brief: 提出免训练的 CF-Prune，利用指令与动作注意力在早期去噪步识别任务相关未来帧 token 并剪枝，结合熵驱动阶段判定，加速世界动作模型推理。
result.reason: Training-free token pruning for pretrained world action models that jointly predict future frames and actions; efficiency for action-conditioned video world models, though no new representation learning.
